name: The landing band switches from the example to the saved trips after a reload

planSteps.description: Navigate to /?today=2026-10-19&fresh=1: the count band (data-testid=count-band) shows the example history (data-source=example)
Add a trip 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-10 and save
Reload /?today=2026-10-19 (no fresh): the band reads 'Your saved trips, read on 2026-10-19' (data-source=saved)
